Package models

Class ReservationExperience

java.lang.Object
models.ReservationExperience
public class ReservationExperience extends Object
Represents a booked experience attached to a specific reservation in the MIRAGE system.

A ReservationExperience is the join entity between a Reservation and a GuestExperience. It records which experience was booked, which concierge handled it, the actual amount charged (which may differ from the experience's base cost), and the date it was booked.

Constraints enforced at insert time by ExperienceDAO:

  • The experience must belong to the same hotel as the reservation's suite.
  • The concierge must also belong to that same hotel.

Database mapping: reservation_experience table.

  • Constructor Details

    • ReservationExperience

      public ReservationExperience(int reservationId, int experienceId, int coniergeId, double actualCost, LocalDate bookedDate)
      Creates a new ReservationExperience linking a reservation to an experience, with the associated concierge and billing details. resExpId is left at 0 until persisted and the key is set via setResExpId(int).
      Parameters:
      reservationId - the ID of the parent reservation; must be positive
      experienceId - the ID of the experience being booked; must be positive
      coniergeId - the ID of the concierge managing this experience; must be positive
      actualCost - the actual amount to charge in USD; must be non-negative
      bookedDate - the date the experience was booked; must not be null
